status: frozen before downloading any analysis-grade event or calibration product
purpose: Acquire the public Chandra products needed to reprocess and fit matched AS295 and PLCK G287 temperature maps without using lensing information.
exclusions: derived count images already acquired by P0640
claim_boundary: All products are detector events or calibration/observation metadata; no lensing target is opened.
Level-1 events and calibration ancillaries are retained because the Chandra X-ray Center recommends reprocessing with the current CALDB.
The archived Level-2 event is retained only as a reproducibility control and will not replace current-CALDB reprocessing.
Successful acquisition does not imply that a valid temperature map or thermal-stress source has been constructed.
